name: cadence-desktop
description: Music library indexer and Android playback host

nsis.preinstallSection:
Section FirewallNotice
  MessageBox MB_OK|MB_ICONEXCLAMATION "IMPORTANT: Allow Cadence through Windows Firewall$
$
Cadence advertises itself on your local network (mDNS) and accepts connections from the Android app over WebSockets (port 7878).$
$
When Cadence first starts, Windows will ask whether to allow it on your network. Select Allow, otherwise your phone will not be able to find this computer." /SD IDOK
SectionEnd
